patterns.note: High-contrast, elegant serif headings (Source Serif 4) paired with clean, neutral sans-serif body text (Inter) and monospaced metadata, creating an academic, editorial aesthetic.
A warm, paper-like off-white background (#fbfaf6) contrasted with deep charcoal text (#2b2b29) and soft, muted sage-green accents (#c8e1dd), evoking a premium gallery or literary journal.
Asymmetrical grid layouts featuring classical oil painting fragments juxtaposed with sharp, modern UI elements and pixelated halftone textures.
Scroll-driven card stacking in the testimonial section where cards slide up and stack on top of each other, combined with subtle parallax reveals on the fragmented art grid.
A distinctive 'ecosystem grid' that uses classical paintings as card backgrounds, blending historical art with modern tech labels.

technique_notes: Juxtapose classical Renaissance oil paintings with modern digital artifacts (like halftone-patterned laptop screens and vector crop marks) to visually represent the intersection of human art history and AI.
Create a sticky stacking card effect for testimonials where each subsequent card slides up and partially overlaps the previous one, anchored by a scroll-bound container.
Implement a multi-column grid of image fragments that animate or fade in with a slight parallax offset on scroll, simulating the assembly of a puzzle or canvas.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body size) paired with small, wide-spaced sans-serif labels and metadata.

standout: The brilliant juxtaposition of classical Renaissance oil paintings with modern digital elements—like historical figures using halftone-patterned laptops—which perfectly visualizes the concept of 'human taste training AI'.
